regla: ¡Ni que + subjunctive! rejects someone's attitude as exaggerated or absurd: ¿Mil pesos? ¡Ni que fuera rica! = It's not like I'm rich! Mostly imperfect subjunctive; also present or pluperfect subjunctive.

bloques.texto: Means _it's not like..., anyone would think..., what, are you...?_ It mocks or rejects something as over the top.
Usually **imperfect subjunctive**: **ni que fuera, ni que tuvieras**.
Also present (**ni que te vaya a morder**) or pluperfect (**ni que hubiera robado un banco**).

lista.es: Javier quiere que le preste diez mil pesos. ¡==Ni que estuviera== loca!
lista.en: Javier wants me to lend him ten thousand pesos. As if I were crazy!

lista.es: Quítate tanto maquillaje. ==Ni que tuvieras== quince años.
lista.en: Take off some of that makeup. It's not like you're fifteen.

lista.es: No sé qué le ves. ==Ni que fuera== actor de cine.
lista.en: I don't know what you see in him. It's not like he's a movie star.

lista.es: ¿Cuántas maletas llevas? ==Ni que te fueras== un año.
lista.en: How many suitcases are you taking? Anyone would think you were going for a year.

lista.es: No te alejes tanto, ==ni que te vaya a morder==.
lista.en: Don't back away, it's not like I'm going to bite you.

lista.es: Ya no regañes al niño, ==ni que hubiera robado== un banco.
lista.en: Stop scolding the boy, it's not like he robbed a bank.

filas.t: Me hablas como si fuera rico.

lista.nota: Same irony; **como si** is part of a longer sentence.

lista.texto: [[8245|como si + imperfect subjunctive for a reproach]].

bloques.texto: Say it out loud, then open the answer.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Calm down, it's not like it's the end of the world._
lista.r: Cálmate, ni que fuera el fin del mundo.

lista.p: In Spanish: _Why so formal? It's not like we didn't know each other._
lista.r: ¿Por qué tan formal? Ni que no nos conociéramos.

lista.p: Fix it: _¡Ni que eres mi mamá!_
